name: Prima ☆ Stella
source:
Kousuke Sakaki was a student and a swimmer who was hoped to participate in the world tournament. However, Kousuke was involved in a big accident trying to help a pedestrian. He was put into a coma as a consequence, but he miraculously regains his consciousness. Even though fate was against him, Kousuke starts moving towards his “dream” again.

Although he miraculously awakened, he couldn’t put strain on his body. As the Winter season was about to begin, Kousuke’s environment kept on becoming tough.

At such time, a certain person comes to his school. The person was related to the Saint Étoile Girl’s Academy, full of students from powerful families. That person tells Kousuke, “If you wish, our school will do what we can to help you” Supposedly the person who Kousuke saved during the accident was a noteworthy figure in the Saint Étoile Girl’s Academy.

Kousuke makes a decision. Nothing will change in this situation, so he decides to do what he can. He accepts the invitation and transfers to the all girl’s school, Saint Étoile Girl’s Academy.

It was also the first time for the cloistered girl students to be so close to a guy of their same age… 

[From [url=http://www.akiba-ch.com/?p=528]Akihabara Channel[/url]]
translation:
榊晃辅是一名学生，也是一位被寄予参加世界大赛厚望的游泳选手。然而，晃辅为了帮助一名行人而遭遇严重事故，并因此陷入昏迷，之后却奇迹般恢复了意识。纵使命运百般阻挠，他仍再次向自己的“梦想”迈进。

尽管奇迹般苏醒，他的身体却无法承受负荷。随着冬季临近，晃辅所处的环境也愈发严峻。

就在此时，某个人来到他的学校。对方与圣艾托瓦尔女子学园有关，那里汇聚了许多权贵家庭的学生。那个人告诉晃辅：“只要你愿意，我们学校会尽力帮助你。”据说，晃辅在事故中救下的人，是圣艾托瓦尔女子学园的一位重要人物。

晃辅作出了决定。继续留在原地什么也不会改变，所以他要做自己力所能及的事。他接受邀请，转入女校圣艾托瓦尔女子学园。

而对那些深居简出的女学生而言，这也是她们第一次如此接近同龄男生……
